recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white portrait of a woman with voluminous, textured hair, integrated into a multi-layered collage featuring a muted purple background, a torn orange paper edge, and vibrant, gestural neon scribbles.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subject against a desaturated purple field
Torn paper texture creating a vertical division on the left
Gestural, hand-drawn neon elements interacting with the subject's accessories
Fluid, script-based typography anchored in the upper right quadrant
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white skin tones
Vibrant orange and blue accent scribbles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-left, large scale, cropped at the waist with a dynamic lean.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast face and voluminous hair serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down the body's diagonal lean, then up to the typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper right and lower left to balance the dense central figure.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Orange and Cobalt Blue (Graphic elements)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in small graphic accents contrasts with a low-saturation background and grayscale subject.

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weight mimicking a felt-tip marker
Rapid, gestural strokes with long descenders and ascenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Secondary text in a similar gestural style but in a contrasting color (orange) and smaller scale.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the energy and fluidity of the original

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a woman with big 80s hair, wearing a black jacket. Place her against a muted lavender background. Add a vertical torn-paper edge on the left showing bright orange underneath. Include gestural orange and blue marker scribbles on her jewelry and wrist.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom hand-lettered script in the top right corner. Use cobalt blue for the primary line and bright orange for the secondary line, ensuring a fluid, marker-drawn appearance.

verificationChecks: Does the torn paper edge look tactile and irregular?
Are the neon scribbles gestural rather than geometric?
Is the typography positioned in the upper right negative space?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: High-contrast tonal range in the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lavender background is desaturated
Verify the orange and blue accents pop against the background
Confirm the lettering looks hand-drawn and marker-based
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast grayscale subject with a desaturated color field, bisected by a high-saturation torn-paper texture and accented with gestural neon marker strokes and fluid script typography.
